description: This file defines classes and enums related to concrete module types in PyTorch's JIT compiler, including builders for constructing concrete module types, and the final concrete module type class used during compilation and attribute access.

classes.name: ConcreteModuleTypeBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing concrete module types during the ScriptModule conversion process.

classes.name: ConcreteModuleType
classes.description: Finalized class representing a concrete module type used during method compilation and attribute access.

methods.name: addConstant
methods.description: Adds a constant value to the module type, either from a py::object or an IValue.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute with its type and flags indicating if it is a parameter or buffer.

methods.name: addFunctionAttribute
methods.description: Adds a function attribute with its type and associated Python function.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Adds a submodule's concrete type information.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a shared pointer to a finalized ConcreteModuleType.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Compares this builder with another for equality based on their contained data.
